description: Headline measures: the flagship numbers a summary shows for every processor, and the ones a compare puts first. A headline applies to processors of the kinds in `processors` (every kind when absent), and selects the measure keys whose quantity is `quantity`, whose family is one of `families` (any family when absent) and, when `dims` is given, whose identity dims, with their defaults filled in, equal one of its objects. Its value on a processor is the best reading of those keys there, over every backend, named with the backend and the reading it came from: a raw measurement, never a derived score. Results format: docs/format-v4.md.
